guarantees.claim: keccak_ack is driven as the logical AND of keccak_valid_o and keccak_ready_i.

assumptions.claim: msg_partial is only asserted at the end of a message and must be sampled together with msg_valid_i; after a partial transfer (msg_valid_i & msg_partial & msg_ready_o), no further msg_valid_i is asserted until process_latched is high.
assumptions.cond: when a partial message byte is being transferred into the pad
assumptions.risk: If the producer violates this, additional data may be accepted after a partial end, causing incorrect SHA‑3 padding and breaking hash integrity.
